messages:
ellie: OK this is important: I composed a 12-second office anthem for Sir Mossington (the fern by the ramen station). please listen in your head. chorus: 'Oh Sir Mossington, thrive on dry desks, photosynthesize our standups' :laughing:
sam: omg please sing it at company karaoke night :joy::raised_hands:
maria: adding harmonies. also we should make a tiny flag for Sir Mossington. who can craft? :seedling:
joel: I have a 3D printer. lowkey can make a moss-sized throne. schedule me in :grin:
kira: can we get a little LED spotlight too? it deserves stage lighting. :spotlight:
nick: ops-bot FYI we will be promoting a plant to 'Employee of the Month' next week — want me to set a recurring reminder?
ops-bot: reminder created: "Plant of the Month nomination" every 1st of month at 10:00. :robot_face:
ellie: poll time: react with :crown: for throne+spotlight, :flag-white: for tiny flag only, or :microphone: for anthem first at the all-hands. also open to alternative titles for Sir Mossington (current contenders: Sir Mossington, The Great Foliage, Moss Boss)
maria: :crown: for throne
sam: :microphone: we must debut the anthem
joel: :crown:
kira: :flag-white: I'm sentimental about flags
ellie: love this energy. next steps: joel and sam will coordinate throne prototype and anthem arrangement. I'll draft a 3-line bio for Sir Mossington to hang next to the ramen station. will post pics. :camera_with_flash:
maria: obligatory caption idea: "Keeps the office oxygen-rich and morale higher than soil pH" :seedling::trophy:
sam: can we make a tiny nameplate: "Sir Mossington, Keeper of Breakroom Tranquility"
ellie: yes. that's the nameplate. end of lore thread (for now) :herb:
